payload.title: change_review cycles never run the tool manifest sync, so in a room store (harness.py review-change, a fresh directory) the change-review tool is not registered and bridge_defect_claims raises tool not found for every answer; the registry row the bridge enforces is also refreshed only by standard cycles while the model's contract renders from the shipped manifest
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle.py:3728-3732 (tool_manifest_sync is declared without modes, so the CyclePhase default of standard only applies)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle.py:3780-3785 (change_intelligence, the phase that mints the claim request, runs in standard and change_review)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_review.py:372 (the bridge reads the tool with get_tool(TOOL_ID, root))
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/tool_registry.py:859-862 (a store without a registry file holds no tools)
tools/aria-acceptance/harness.py:543-551 (the room runs only change_review cycles against the explicit store)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/agent_invocations.py:4909-4916 (a GovernanceError from the supporting bridge becomes bridge_errors and a warning row, never a raise)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_review.py:103-110 (the model's contract renders from the shipped manifest, while the bridge enforces the registry row)
payload.rule_violated: The registered tool is the one source of the claim families (change_review.py module docstring and SPEC point 2: ONE tool run of the registered tool change-review); a path that ships the contract must also ship the registration
payload.notes: review-change runs cycle run --mode change_review repeatedly against a plain store directory, and none of those cycles registers tools/aria-adapters/change-review.tool.json. Probed at d716541239 with a fresh ensure_tools_dir store: bridge_defect_claims(request, claims=[]) raises GovernanceError 'tool not found: change-review'. So no change-review run and no raw row is written for an answer that carries defect_claims; the failure shows only as bridge_errors and an agent_bridge_warning row, and the request is not in a settled ACCEPTED state while its bridge is pending or failed (agent_invocations.py:3262-3271). In a store synced earlier and a kernel whose manifest later gained or dropped a family, the model is told the manifest's families and the bridge refuses a new one claim_rule_unknown, because only a standard cycle refreshes the row. Close condition: Make change_review cycles register the agent-backed manifests (a CYCLE_PHASES row that carries the change_review mode and registers them, without the full sync's promotion lane). Test: a fresh store after one change_review cycle holds change-review, bridge_defect_claims on it returns counts instead of raising, and its families equal shipped_claim_families(). Plan row: D3 (program finding ARIA-MEDIUM-761). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
